title: A failed keep-settings install never rolls back the new exposure migration and so also leaves the forced camera rate

expected.what: The exposure migration rewrites the user's settings and profile INIs after the camera_rate migration, but the rollback never restores the exposure snapshot, so a failed install leaves exposure forced.
Rollback restores only the rate snapshot, whose recorded hash no longer matches after the exposure rewrite of the same files, so the restore reports a conflict and the forced camera_rate stays too.

evidence: Restore-TaxiSettingsSnapshot refuses an entry whose hash differs from the one it installed, so restoring the rate snapshot alone fails after the exposure rewrite. The fix restores exposure first, then rate.
